# Coorg Stays

> Comprehensive guide to resorts, homestays, and tourism in Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka - featuring coffee plantations, Western Ghats attractions, and authentic local experiences.

Coorg Stays helps travelers discover and book accommodations across Kodagu district, from luxury plantation resorts to riverside homestays. The site covers major destinations including Madikeri, Kushalnagar, and Nagarhole, along with detailed guides to attractions, activities, and cultural experiences in Karnataka's coffee country.

## Key Topics

- Coorg (Kodagu)
- Coffee Plantations
- Homestays & Resorts
- Madikeri
- Kushalnagar
- Golden Temple Coorg
- Tibetan Monastery
- Western Ghats
- Nagarhole National Park
- Kaveri River
- Trekking
- Pilgrimage Sites
- Karnataka Tourism
- Plantation Stays
- Luxury Accommodation

- [Kaveri Riverside Plantation Homestay](https://www.coorgstays.in/accommodation/kaveri-riverside-plantation-homestay): Riverside plantation homestay near Golden Temple & Tibetan Monastery
- [Organic Farm Stay in Coorg](https://www.coorgstays.in/accommodation/organic-farm-stay-in-coorg): Organic farm stay near Kushalnagar, Golden Temple & Tibetan Monastery
- [Madikeri Plantation Retreat](https://www.coorgstays.in/accommodation/madikeri-plantation-retreat): Madikeri plantation retreat near Golden Temple & Tibetan Monastery

- [Country Holiday Resort](https://www.coorgstays.in/accommodation/country-holiday-resort): Country Holiday Resort near Kushalnagar & Tibetan Golden Temple

## Tour Packages

- [Coorg Monsoon Package](https://www.coorgstays.in/tour/coorg-monsoon-package): 3-day monsoon package: Western Ghats waterfalls & coffee plantations tour
- [Coorg Luxury Plantation Stay Tour](https://www.coorgstays.in/tour/coorg-plantation-stay-tour): Luxury coffee/tea plantation stay tour in Madikeri with trekking

## Major Attractions

- [Talakaveri](https://www.coorgstays.in/things-to-do/talakaveri): Talakaveri: Kaveri River source on Brahmagiri hill, pilgrimage site
- [Kaveri Nisargadhama](https://www.coorgstays.in/things-to-do/kaveri-nisargadhama): Kaveri Nisargadhama river island attraction near Kushalnagar with activities
- [Bhagamandala](https://www.coorgstays.in/things-to-do/bhagamandala): Bhagamandala temple at Kaveri river confluence in Kodagu
- [Thirunelli Temple](https://www.coorgstays.in/things-to-do/thirunelli-temple): Ancient Vishnu temple in Kerala for ancestral rites and pilgrimage

## Travel Guides & Experiences

- [Trending Hot Destination - South Coorg (Kutta)](https://www.coorgstays.in/trending-hot-destination-south-coorg-kutta): South Coorg (Kutta) guide: wildlife safari, rafting, trekking near Bramagiri
- [Workation in Coorg : A Perfect Blend of Work and Leisure](https://www.coorgstays.in/workcation-in-coorg-a-perfect-blend-of-work-and-leisure): Remote work destination guide for Coorg with coffee plantations & culture
- [Historical Places In Coorg](https://www.coorgstays.in/historical-places-in-coorg): Historical sites: Bylakuppe monasteries, Madikeri Fort, royal tombs
- [Team Outing in Coorg – Ultimate Guide to Corporate Retreats](https://www.coorgstays.in/team-outing-in-coorg): Corporate retreat guide: team building activities & resorts near Bangalore
- [The Taste of Coorg](https://www.coorgstays.in/the-taste-of-coorg): Kodava cuisine guide: traditional dishes and authentic homestay dining
